name: funnel-chart
title: Funnel chart
description: Steps of a process with how many reach each one and the conversion between them.

when: Where people drop out of a flow.

instead.when: The steps are independent categories, not a sequence people drop out of.
The steps are a flow to complete, not counts to compare.

builtIn: A "Show as table" button shows the same data as a table, which screen readers get by default.
youProvide: A title that says what the figure is.
